newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice falls sharply as longs liquidate July.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice falls sharply as longs liquidate July.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday as longs liquidated the July contract, pit sources said.
New crop months continued to struggle after U.S. Agriculture Department acreage projections put new crop plantings at roughly three million acres, up from 2.8 million plnated last year.
Meanwhile, domestic and export demand remained thin.
"We're taking this market down to try to build some demand," one floor source said. "The market is already trading substantially below cash and there's still no business.
Rice ended 25 to 16 cents per cwt lower with July off 16 at $10.42.
Volume was estimated by CBOT 800 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 1,353 lots.
